name: Mohamed SOUEILEM
summary: Senior Software Engineer with more than seven years of full-stack experience, specializing in scalable software solutions, performance optimization, and cross-functional team leadership. Proven track record of mentoring junior engineers, owning end-to-end projects, and aligning development with business goals. Experienced in Agile, DevOps, and CI/CD environments, with a strong focus on code quality, delivery speed, and engineering excellence.

experience.title: Software Engineer II
responsibilities: Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain clean, maintainable, and efficient software solutions using DevOps model in collaboration with Product Management.
Participate in design reviews and architectural design of new features and systems, ensuring scalability, reliability, and maintainability.

Review code by other developers and provide feedback to ensure that code adhered to best practices like coding guidelines, elegant, efficient and maintainable code, with observability built from ground up.
Build testable software, define tests, participate in testing, and automate tests using tools (e.g., Junit, Selenium) and Design Patterns that are guided by test automation pyramid.
Triage defects or customer reported issues; debug and resolve in a timely and efficient manner.
Contribute to maintaining health and quality of services; promptly identify and escalate issues. Utilize health indicators and telemetry for action.
Assist in conducting root cause analysis and implementing measures to prevent future recurrences.
Properly document new product features, enhancements, or fixes. Contribute to training materials.

experience.title: Principal
responsibilities: Recruited more than 30 full-time interns across software development, UI/UX, and digital marketing to build real-world, production-level experience. Established culture of hands-on learning and peer collaboration, with interns moving into team leadership roles.
Designed and implemented new operational structures, including onboarding, workflows, and internal communications.
Instituted best practices and standardized processes (code reviews, daily stand-ups, project tracking) that increased delivery consistency and reduced rework by 40% across remote teams.

experience.title: Co-Founder & Software Developer
responsibilities: Created ride-sharing application (“Rose Ride”) like Uber. Designed user-friendly and visually appealing UI for Rose Ride.
Enhanced user engagement with real-time updates and push notifications via Firebase back end and GCP.
Implemented support in three languages using localization packages.
Ensured 100% error-free code with Dart null safety.
Improved global app security and data accessibility with secure storage solutions.

experience.title: Software Developer
responsibilities: Proposed automated peer review strategy and evaluated five technical approaches. Selected optimal stack that was well-known to team. Conceived, designed, and implemented strategy as React-based Chrome extension to automate peer review.
Applied engineering principles to entire SDLC for peer review automation. Streamlined code review for five teams and achieved 90% faster problem discovery rate.
Mentored seven junior developers, introducing code standards, documentation, and pair programming. Led initiatives that cut onboarding time by 70% and post-deployment bugs by 35%.
Upgraded deprecated Chrome extension to Manifest V3, enhancing functionality and compatibility; refactored legacy JS to TypeScript, reducing runtime errors by 20%.
Created custom pharma page program that increased user engagement by 35% and conversion rate by 20% within three months.
Improved user experience by 30% and decreased bounce rate by 15% through responsive design and user-side logic.

experience.title: Software Developer
responsibilities: Optimized development processes by 20% through technology integration.

Chose and implemented testing tool that improved code quality by 40% and decreased testing time by 30%. Developed test plans and ensured solution accuracy and reliability via comprehensive unit testing.
Improved data retrieval speed by caching SQL data in Redis.
Researched and integrated new technologies to optimize development. Modernized user interface by upgrading system UI to Angular, then to React. Contributed to new UX versions using Vue.js.
